edges.label: Exploit CVE-2023-4863 in pillow 8.0.0
edges.evidence: Django storefront on port 443 open to the internet; CVE-2023-4863 in CISA KEV (exploited in the wild)
edges.fix: Upgrade django to 3.2.14 and pillow to 10.0.1 on web-prod-1 (2 exploitable CVEs), or remove internet access to port 443

edges.label: Use the attached role's credentials
edges.evidence: web-prod-1 runs as role web-app-role; credentials available from the instance metadata service (IMDSv1 also allows SSRF theft)

edges.label: Brute-force SSH password
edges.evidence: Port 22 open to the internet with password login enabled
edges.fix: Close port 22 to the internet; use SSM Session Manager and key-only auth

edges.label: Use the attached role's credentials
edges.evidence: bastion-1 runs as role bastion-role; credentials available from the instance metadata service

edges.label: Exploit CVE-2023-4863 in pillow 8.0.0

edges.label: Use the attached role's credentials

edges.label: Assume role trusted by a third party
edges.evidence: Role vendor-audit-role trusts the whole account 444455556666 with no ExternalId condition; a compromise of that vendor (or a confused deputy) reaches this account
edges.fix: Add an sts:ExternalId condition to vendor-audit-role's trust policy and trust a specific role ARN

edges.label: Use a leaked long-lived access key
edges.evidence: ci-bot has an access key 412 days old and no MFA
edges.fix: Rotate and remove ci-bot's access key; use short-lived credentials (OIDC / IAM roles)

edges.label: Assume role deploy-role
edges.evidence: web-app-role may call sts:AssumeRole on deploy-role, and deploy-role's trust policy allows it
edges.fix: Remove web-app-role from deploy-role's trust policy, or narrow its sts:AssumeRole permission

edges.label: Read acme-customer-data
edges.evidence: web-app-role may call s3:GetObject on acme-customer-data
edges.fix: Remove s3:GetObject on acme-customer-data from web-app-role if it is not needed

edges.label: Escalate: Launch an instance with an admin role
edges.evidence: deploy-role has iam:PassRole + ec2:RunInstances on all resources
edges.fix: Remove or scope iam:PassRole + ec2:RunInstances for deploy-role
